description: PAID (x402 exact/EVM, 1 USDC-cent per call). Re-plan a journey for a traveller already on a delayed train: per-stop transfer buffer, onward connections with arrival times, and one safe recommendation. Call it without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object; retry with the payment payload in params._meta['x402/payment'].

manual_delay.description: Known delay in minutes, if the feed has none.

name: plan_transfer
